_about: AUDIT-100 A2. The /api routes the Supabase Edge Function `projexa-api` (compliance-tracker supabase/functions/projexa-api) answers instead of Vercel. DENY BY DEFAULT: the function answers 404 for every path not listed here. Each entry must be a `veridian-proxy` route of ai-os/audit37/vercel-route-inventory.json and must describe EXACTLY what its Next handler sends upstream (src/app/api/<route>/route.ts); the parity contract (src/lib/projexa-api-parity.test.ts) proves it per route, method and role. `batch` is the move this route came in with (AUDIT-100 A2 batch 1 = the shell's 7 routes, batch 2 = the 40 most-used plain proxies of the online screens, 3-4 = the rest of the plain ones, 5 = own role sets, VERIDIAN root, empty / lenient / defaulted bodies; ai-os/audit37/A2_PROGRESS.md). Regenerate the function's table with `bun scripts/projexa-api-edge.mjs --write [--ct <compliance-tracker checkout>]`.
